optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's role as associate-grade reviewer on eleven credit risk model validations, including performing validation testing, drafting findings, and maintaining review boundaries, but do not establish that the candidate was the senior reviewer of record (signing validation reports), set validation scope with model owners, supervised associate reviewers, or presented findings to the model risk committee. The candidate's LinkedIn title and recruiter comments suggest senior-level activity but do not confirm the required senior reviewer role.

decisionBoundary.statement: Qualified human review is required before any employment decision due to evidence gaps in senior reviewer role and presentation to committee.

evidence.text: candidate said she has been 'operating at a senior level' and was 'effectively the senior reviewer' on most of the eleven reviews because the reviewer of record 'only signed'; asked whether she had signed a report herself, she said not yet.
evidence.notes: Candidate claims 'effectively senior reviewer' but explicitly states she did not sign reports.

missingEvidence: Candidate signed validation reports as senior reviewer of record.

evidence.text: working as second reviewer on eleven credit risk model validations under the reviewer of record.
evidence.notes: Candidate was second reviewer, not setting scope or supervising.

missingEvidence: Candidate set validation scope with model owners.

evidence.text: attended the model risk committee with the reviewer of record for four of the reviews.
evidence.notes: Candidate attended committee meetings but did not present findings.

missingEvidence: Candidate presented findings to the model risk committee.

evidence.text: Performed the validation testing on those reviews under the bank's validation standard: replication of the model estimates, benchmark model comparison and stability testing, with the test workbooks filed in the validation repository.

Work sample: the test workbook and the drafted findings section for one credit risk model validation, with the validation repository references as a verification trail; the signed report carries the reviewer of record's signature.

Drafted the findings sections and the open items list of the validation reports, which the reviewer of record edited and signed; attended the model risk committee with the reviewer of record for four of the reviews.
Kept the review boundary section of each report current and maintained the validation function's testing template after the 2024 standard update.
